proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for William Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requires the Board to adopt a policy that the Chair of the Board be an independent member of the Board, with limited exceptions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: How votes are counted
proposals.proponent: Newground Social investment, as agent for Ms. Mercy A. Rome and Equality Network Foundation, co-sponsored by First Affirmative Financial Network, LLC, as proxy for Ms. Katherine E. Stearns, and United Church Funds
proposals.topic_summary: Asks that non-binding shareholder proposals be decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Vesting for government service
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity-based awards for senior executives due to voluntary resignation to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Appoint a stockholder value committee
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to appoint an independent-director committee to assess whether divesting non-core banking business segments would enhance shareholder value and to report publicly.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Clawback amendment
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to amend the clawback policy to defer a substantial portion of executive pay for 10 years to help satisfy monetary penalties for violations of law.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Executive compensation philosophy
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Firm to adopt an executive compensation philosophy considering relevant social factors to improve ethical conduct and public reputation.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
